name: Solo Guitarist
style: Blues, roots, jazz and Spanish flavors
spec: One guitarist, with or without vocals
alt: An acoustic guitar leaning against a weathered green door on a stone step.
blurb: A solo guitarist is a great fit for a cocktail hour, a client dinner or a private dinner, playing blues, roots, jazz and Spanish flavors soft enough that your guests can keep talking. The guitarist can sing or keep it instrumental, and usually all we need is a small corner of your venue.
